title: Gothic Cathedral Vision
description: A surreal double exposure portrait of a woman's face merged with a towering Gothic cathedral. The right side of her face is adorned with vibrant holly leaves and red berries, while cosmic galaxies, stars, and dripping magenta liquid elements blend with the dark architecture against a dramatic, cloudy sky.
prompt: surreal double exposure of a woman's face blended with a towering dark Gothic cathedral, her right side covered in detailed holly leaves and red berries with dripping magenta liquid, cosmic galaxies and swirling stars in the lower portion, dramatic cloudy sky background, intricate stained glass windows, ethereal and mystical atmosphere, rich textures and cinematic lighting
